title: Vibrant Spicy Dutch Chicken Skillet
description: A solo dinner Dutch dish featuring garlicky flavors and birds-eye chillies, made with long-fermentation-dough for a unique twist, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced birds-eye chillies to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crumbled long-fermentation-dough to the skillet, stirring to combine with the chicken and chillies.
Season the mixture with salt, black pepper, and paprika, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve the Vibrant Spicy Dutch Chicken Skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
